title: Daily digest: Officials more corrupt than politicians, | Revanth Reddy Urges Chhattisgarh CM to I | BJP says Opposition ‘politicising’ SC wi | Uttar Pradesh draft electoral roll publi | Model School teachers protest over salar
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Munsif Daily / Deccan Chronicle / The Hindu / Telangana Today
bullets_en: Officials more corrupt than politicians, says Jadcherla MLA.
Revanth reddy urges chhattisgarh cm to issue NOC for sammakka Sagar barrage.
BJP says Opposition ‘politicising’ SC with questions on ECI.
Uttar Pradesh draft electoral roll published, 13.58 crore voters on list.
Model School teachers protest over salary payments in Hyderabad.
bullets_ur: Jadcherla MLA ka kehna hai ke afraad siyasatdanon se ziyada bad-chalan hain.
Revanth Reddy ne Chhattisgarh CM Issue NOC ko Sammakka Sagar Barrage ke liye par zoor diya.
BJP ka kehna hai ke ECI par sawalat utha kar opposition SC par siyasat kar rahi hai.
Uttar Pradesh ka draft electoral roll jari kar diya gaya hai, list mein 13.58 crore voter shamil hain.
Hyderabad mein Model School asaatza ka tankhuwon ki adayegi ke liye ehtijaj.
